newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt says FDA panel backs Albunex.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt says FDA panel backs Albunex.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Tuesday that the Radiology Device Advisory Panel of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration voted seven-to-zero to recommend clearance of Albunex, an ultrasound imaging agent, for use in infertility diagnosis in women.
The specific use voted on by the panel is for diagnosing fallopian tube patency, which refers to the extent to which the fallopian tube is open or obstructed.

Albunex is a product of Molecular Biosystems Inc. Mallinckrodt markets the product and also has been responsible for conducting the clinical trials of Albunex for the indication of diagnosing fallopian tube patency.
Albunex's current indication is for the diagnosis of cardiac disorders.
